title: Unstable Terminal UI: Unexpected Scroll Jumps Disrupting Code View
body:
**Bug Description**
UI keeps randomly teleporting up and down constantly making it so i couldn't see any code :( it was like scrolling up and down randomly to random places in my terminal

**Environment Info**
- Platform: linux
- Terminal: cursor
- Version: 1.0.35
- Feedback ID: e13f06c8-de66-484c-9f83-6356ff6bd861
